units.source_text: 走不到百来米，就听见两个男人的脚步声从背后一溜烟地追赶上来。

en.t: Before she had gone even a hundred meters, she heard the footsteps of two men rushing up behind her.

units.source_text: 女人们则在他们的后面尖声咒骂……

en.t: Behind them, the women were shrieking curses...

units.source_text: 阿泷像摔倒似的忽然伏在河边，咕嘟嘟地大口喝起冰凉的河水来。

en.t: Otaki suddenly dropped down by the river as if she had fallen, and began gulping down the icy river water.

units.source_text: 她隐约看见赤脚飞跑过来的男人们呵出的白气，又喝起水来。

en.t: She dimly saw the white breath of the men running toward her barefoot, then started drinking again.
